name: Torrecilla de la Orden (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white chevron pointing to the fly, charged at the hoist with a red triangle bearing a white Maltese cross.
history: Municipal flag of Torrecilla de la Orden; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the fly corners and pointing to the hoist
triangle with its base at the hoist
